hooks.command: f=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(d).tool_input.file_path||'')}catch{process.stdout.write('')}})"); root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; f="${f#$root/}"; case "$f" in apps/crawler/*.ts|apps/crawler/*.tsx|apps/crawler/*.js|apps/crawler/*.mjs) rel="${f#apps/crawler/}"; (cd "$root/apps/crawler" && pnpm exec prettier --write "$rel" 2>/dev/null); ;; esac; true

hooks.statusMessage: Pre-commit checks for the changed paths

hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/no-script-edits.py" ] || exit 0; cd "$root" && python3 .claude/hooks/no-script-edits.py
